answer.reason: Virginia's private-sector construction employment (NAICS 23) has consistently been in the low-to-mid 200,000s range in recent BLS data, with QCEW covered employment around 220,000-235,000 in late 2024. A figure of 469,073 would be roughly double the actual size of Virginia's construction sector and is inconsistent with any published BLS series for NAICS 23 in Virginia; it is more characteristic of a much larger sector (e.g., trade/transportation/utilities or education/health services). Therefore, 220,976 covered jobs is the supported answer for December 2024 private construction employment in the QCEW data.
